Name: Quick Glance
Author: adverserath
Description:
[b][size=5]QuickGlance [url=https://github.com/adverserath/QuickGlance][size=2]Open Source (GitHub)[/size]
[/url]﻿[/size][/b]

Gives you the ability to map keys to instantly zoom out to a desired level and release to reset to the previous zoom. Default Values are Controller LeftStick and Keyboard Home.


[b]V1.0.7
[/b]Config can be edited directly in the config.json file, or in game directly using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GenericModConfigMenu[/url]

  "ZoomKeys": "Home",
  "ZoomLevel": 0.5,
  "ToggleZoom": false





[b]
Everything below for V1.0.6 and below[/b]

Optionally you can have the zoom toggle off and on instead of release by setting the below value in the config[code]"ToggleZoom": true
[/code]

To override the values, set the integers in the config file. You can also alter the zoom level (default is 0.5f)
[code]{
  "ZoomKey1": 2064,
  "ZoomKey2": 36,
  "ZoomLevel": 0.5,
  "ToggleZoom": false
}
[/code]
